title: Treatment for sensitive teeth
what: The dentist coats the sensitive spots on your teeth with a protective layer. Your teeth then react less to cold, sour, and sweet.
why: When your teeth ache from cold, hot, sweet, or brushing.
duration: usually 15 to 40 minutes; the effect is often felt right away or after a few sessions
tell_doctor: Which teeth react, and to what
If you recently had your teeth whitened
If you have heartburn or vomit often
What toothpaste and toothbrush you use

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth with a soft brush before the visit.

prepare.title: Notice
prepare.text: Notice what exactly causes the pain. It will help your dentist.

steps: The dentist checks your teeth and finds the sensitive spots
A protective coating goes on the sensitive spots
Sometimes an exposed tooth root is covered with a filling
The dentist recommends a toothpaste and home care
feel: The air jet may sting a sensitive tooth
after: Do not eat or drink for as long as your dentist says, usually 30 to 60 minutes
Use a soft brush and the toothpaste your dentist recommends
Sometimes the treatment needs to be repeated
red_flags: A tooth hurts on its own, at night, or long after something cold: see your dentist. It may be more than sensitivity

faq.q: Why have my teeth become sensitive?
faq.a: Often because of worn enamel or an exposed tooth root. Your dentist will find the cause.
It often helps if you use it regularly. Your dentist can suggest one.

reminders.text: Dentist visit in 2 hours. Brush your teeth with a soft brush.
